label: early-position (slots 2-3) content-dependent candidate unit
explanation: Activity is concentrated at original positions t=2-3 and copy steps outputting original tokens 2-3 (79% of dev activation mass), never at t=0, almost never at the delimiter or at original positions >=5, and more frequent for short sequences (L=3-4). Within that window, firing depends on token content in a way no simple predicate captures: rates go up when the output/first token is e or y, or the input is r/u/o/2, but adding these conditions only gets F1 to about 0.30. The positional predicate recorded here has low precision (~0.12), so it describes where the unit can fire, not when it does. Top activations (L=3-4) come on the copy step that inputs original token 1 and outputs original token 2, usually when that token is e.
